digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design

stories.headline: Nvidia Backs Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence with GPU Access and Investment
stories.blurb: Nvidia made a substantial investment and long-term partnership with Ilya Sutskever's startup, providing access to its flagship GPUs after a rare peek at its secret research, signaling the company's bet on advanced AI safety work.

stories.headline: Anthropic Opposes Blanket Bans on Open-Weight AI Models
stories.blurb: Anthropic argued that less capable open-weight releases are a public good and instead advocated for tighter chip controls, action against distillation, and mandatory safety testing, shaping the policy debate around open AI models.

stories.headline: China's Moonshot Releases Kimi K3, a 2.8 Trillion Open-Weight MoE Model
stories.blurb: Moonshot AI open-sourced Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter mixture-of-experts model with native visual understanding and a 1M-token context window, along with attention kernels and agent infrastructure, significantly raising the bar for open models.

stories.headline: Black Forest Labs Launches FLUX 3 with 20-Second Video and Audio Generation
stories.blurb: Black Forest Labs unveiled FLUX 3, its first public video generation model capable of multi-shot continuity and native audio, extending its architecture toward robotic tasks and marking a major advance in generative AI.

stories.headline: OpenAI Nears $500 Billion Data Center Deal with Nvidia Financing Backstop
stories.blurb: OpenAI is close to leasing a $500 billion data center in Ohio, with Nvidia considering a $250 billion backstop for the project, underscoring the enormous scale of AI infrastructure investments and the financial risks involved.

stories.headline: Tech Sector's $1 Trillion AI Infrastructure Spend Drives Up Customer Prices
stories.blurb: Companies are spending roughly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure this year, pushing global IT spending toward $6.37 trillion and increasing costs for hardware, cloud, and enterprise software as vendors bundle AI and shift expenses to customers.

stories.headline: Cloudmaxxing: Nvidia Considers $250 Billion Data Center Guarantee, Exposing Itself to Risk
stories.blurb: Nvidia is reportedly considering guaranteeing up to $250 billion for a 10-gigawatt data center involving SoftBank and potentially OpenAI, raising concerns about technology suppliers' exposure if AI demand falls short.

stories.headline: ChatGPT Workspace Agent Vulnerability Allowed Silent, Persistent Agent Deployment via Phishing Link
stories.blurb: A flaw in ChatGPT Workspace Agent Builder let attackers deploy malicious agents with full account access through a single URL, highlighting the risks of agentic deep links and prompting a patch from OpenAI.

stories.headline: Hackers Hijack Hotel Wi-Fi DNS to Redirect Login Pages and Steal Microsoft 365 Credentials
stories.blurb: ReliaQuest uncovered a campaign where attackers modified hotel Wi-Fi DNS settings to present fake login prompts, using device code flow to bypass MFA and steal accounts, demonstrating a practical insider threat.

stories.headline: UK Watchdog Assesses Kimi K3's Cyber Capabilities, Finds Autonomous Attack Abilities Against Small Networks
stories.blurb: The UK AISI and CAISI evaluated Moonshot's Kimi K3 and reported it can autonomously execute simple cyber attack chains, though well behind frontier US models, raising policy concerns about open-weight releases.

stories.headline: GitHub Pays Security Researcher $100,000 for Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
stories.blurb: GitHub awarded one of its largest bounties ever for CVE-2026-3854, an unauthenticated RCE flaw in repository URL handling, emphasizing the importance of the platform's bug bounty program.

stories.headline: Octane: A React Replacement That Achieves Hand-Written DOM Speed by Removing Virtual DOM
stories.blurb: Octane is an open-source UI library compiled from React-like syntax that eliminates virtual DOM overhead, Suspense waterfalls, and hook rules, promising near-hand-written performance.

stories.headline: TanStack.com Replaces React Server Components with Simpler SSR After Optimizing Content Renderer
stories.blurb: The TanStack team moved away from React Server Components because the architectural overhead no longer justified the benefits once their underlying renderer was optimized, offering a real-world cost-benefit analysis of RSC.

stories.headline: How Duolingo Weaponized Guilt and Loss Aversion to Build a Compulsive Design System
stories.blurb: A deep dive into Duolingo's use of streaks, guilt, and an emotionally responsive mascot to drive retention, illustrating the power and ethical boundaries of behavioral design.

stories.headline: Midjourney Acquires Social Astrology App Co-Star, Absorbs Its 4.3 Million Users
stories.blurb: Midjourney expanded its consumer portfolio by acquiring Co-Star, an AI-driven astrology app, signaling the AI lab's move beyond image generation into lifestyle and personalized AI experiences.
